note: Configuration of the saved head importer (import_native_head.gd): head SPR 1 from native-head-v1/head-slot.json, attack action 86 / direction 6 fixtures under none/cap/hat and the head.json manifest shape. The code lives in art_import.gd. New heads use board_export.gd + import_slot_board.gd instead.

recipeContract.note: What a recipe module using this importer must state (art_recipe.py validates it).

legacyKey.text: r > 0.65 and b > 0.6 and g < 0.45 and r+b-2*g > 0.85 (RGB normalized 0..1)

labels.name: {character} head on original RO attachment action
labels.legacyOperation: Resize entire board to {canvas} nearest-neighbor once, remove magenta background, then fixed {crop} crop. No individual recentering, resizing, silhouette masks, warping, or ACT edits.
labels.indexedOperation: Classify every source pixel against the style palette (magenta edges unmixed), then take the majority class of each fractional block of the whole board, then fixed {crop} crop. No individual recentering, resizing, silhouette masks, warping, or ACT edits.
limits: One facing and one head image slot, reused by all nine native attack frames; not a full head direction library.
Generated replacement face and hair use the original head slot registration and ACT. A headgear module remains a separate original RO reference asset.
Wayfarer costume repaint and original dagger/trail are retained; reference composites use the local renderer, not the official client.
Geometry and timing checks do not constitute artistic approval of the head or every headgear combination.
labels.done: Head imported: one {size} bitmap, {fixtures} native composites; six ACT records unchanged. AlphaIoU: {iou}; pixels outside fixed crop: {outside}
